items.briefing:
With the new school term approaching, Bitdefender is warning Australians and others across the Asia-Pacific region to watch out for school-related scams. These can include fake fee requests, fraudulent school supply offers, or phishing emails targeting parents and students. Separately, a new AI-powered email security tool from Abnormal AI now includes phishing awareness training, which could be useful for organisations looking to strengthen staff defences against increasingly convincing email attacks.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email requesting school fees or personal details, contact the school directly using contact details from their official website — not those in the email.

featured.title: Nasuni acquires DryvIQ to boost file data governance
featured.summary: The deal gives enterprises one platform to classify and govern unstructured files before using them in AI systems, reducing compliance risk.
